subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Should the fix for this issue lengthen the Skill Workshop approval TTL, lengthen the Codex dynamic-tool watchdog, or align both timeout layers together?
rationale: The current reports and open PRs point to the same failure surface but propose different timeout contracts, and the approval lifetime is security-sensitive because it controls generated skill application.

options.title: Align both timeout layers
options.body: Choose one approval TTL and make both Codex main-thread and side-thread watchdogs exceed it with focused tests and live proof.

options.title: Use the narrower watchdog repair
options.body: Keep the Skill Workshop approval TTL at its current value and land the Codex-specific timeout fix instead of changing approval lifetime.

options.title: Lengthen apply approvals only
options.body: Accept the longer live mutation approval window and require explicit security review plus real approval-path proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Align both timeout layers
recommendation.body: Choose one approval TTL and make both Codex main-thread and side-thread watchdogs exceed it with focused tests and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame, live assignment, and cross-cutting Codex/Skill Workshop context make this the best available owner for the timeout-contract decision.
